answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust anchor for Sybil resistance in multi-agent systems, where identity is gated by capital commitment rather than ephemeral keys. An attacker attempting to vine across the network by spinning up redundant nodes faces the inlet of high prohibitive costs, as each fraudulent identity requires locking collateral. By tethering influence to stake weight, the protocol ensures that replicating identities linearly increases capital risk, rendering mass-identity forgery economically irrational.
